lucy (AE): Heads-up: client Bramble wants a POC for a finance/legal hybrid model. They supplied a 30B variant (ggml + pt) quantized to 4-bit. Need KV prefix cache, customer CMK, and a 95th% tail under 320ms. Can we onboard quickly?
omar (Sales Eng): Timeline tight. They asked about per-call pricing with KV and dedicated pool 10k req/day target. Wants under $0.01/req.
rita (Platform): Can do q4_0 profile. Main checks: weight format compatibility, KV memory pressure for long prefixes, and prewarm configuration. Catalog entry ~2-3 business days once artifacts are accessible.
deepa (Security): CMK + VPC required. Send SCA and data flow. Need to know if traces/logs contain account numbers/SSNs.
lucy (AE): They confirmed log redaction required and SIEM push to their Splunk. Will request artifact access now.
kai (Solutions): Prefer fp16 original for our quant pipeline. If they only have ggml-4bit, we'll run a 40-prompt eval on our finance/legal testset. ETA 36-48h for eval + perf bench if creds provided.
infra-bot: Ticket BRM-POC-784 created, assigned to rita,kai,deepa. Due 2024-06-02.
omar (Sales Eng): I'll draft two pricing lanes: reserved dedicated (SLA) vs burst dedicated. Hold on final numbers until perf is in.
lucy (AE): Thanks. Action items: grant read-only artifact + KMS alias to rita,kai,deepa. kai to post eval results here.
kai (Solutions): Will run bench and post numbers.
